jobs.title: DIGITAL MARKETING GENERAL MANAGER (BEAUTY COMPANY)
jobs.description: Apakah Anda Siap Memimpin Digital Marketing untuk Membangun Bisnis Bernilai Triliunan Rupiah? Bergabunglah menjadi Genaral Manager Digital Marketing di Mercier Corp, hanya jika Anda: 1. Memiliki pengalaman memimpin strategi dan eksekusi Digital Marketing secara end-to-end yang menghasilkan pertumbuhan GMV, Revenue, Market Share, dan Profitability dalam skala besar. 2. Mampu mengintegrasikan Performance Marketing, Creative, Brand, KOL, Affiliate, Social Commerce, dan E-Commerce menjadi satu growth engine yang mampu mencapai target bisnis yang ambisius. 3. Terbiasa mengambil keputusan strategis berbasis data, membangun high-performing team, dan mengeksekusi business scaling untuk mencapai target triliunan rupiah per bulan. Mercier Corp adalah perusahaan manufaktur skincare dan kosmetik dengan brand MPM Beauty dan Animate Beauty yang memiliki visi menjadi perusahaan beauty terbaik di Asia . 1. Berpengalaman lebih dari 15 tahun dalam pengembangan dan distribusi produk kecantikan sehingga siap bersaing di pasar internasional. 2. Memiliki ambisi besar untuk menjadi salah satu perusahaan beauty dengan pertumbuhan tercepat di Asia melalui inovasi, digitalisasi, dan eksekusi bisnis kelas dunia. 3. Kami percaya bahwa kecepatan, kreativitas, data, dan eksekusi adalah fondasi utama dalam membangun perusahaan bernilai miliaran hingga triliunan rupiah. 4. Jika Anda ingin membangun legacy, memimpin organisasi digital berkelas dunia, dan menjadi bagian dari perjalanan menuju perusahaan beauty terbesar di Asia, kami menantikan resume Anda. TANGGUNG JAWAB UTAMA 1. Lead Enterprise Digital Growth Strategy dengan merancang dan mengeksekusi strategi Digital & Creative Marketing yang mendorong pertumbuhan GMV, Revenue, Profitability, dan Market Share secara berkelanjutan. 2. Build an Integrated Growth Ecosystem dengan menyatukan strategi Performance Marketing, Creative, Brand, KOL, Affiliate, CRM, Social Commerce, Live Commerce, dan E-Commerce untuk memaksimalkan pertumbuhan bisnis. 3. Drive Commercial Excellence melalui optimalisasi customer acquisition, conversion, retention, dan customer lifetime value (CLV) untuk meningkatkan profitabilitas perusahaan. 4. Lead Data-Driven Business Decisions dengan memanfaatkan business intelligence, marketing analytics, consumer insights, dan AI-driven optimization untuk meningkatkan efektivitas investasi pemasaran. 5. Build & Develop World-Class Teams dengan membangun organisasi yang agile, berorientasi pada hasil, memiliki budaya ownership, innovation, dan continuous improvement. 6. Execute Billion-to-Trillion Growth Roadmap dengan memastikan seluruh strategi digital dan creative berjalan selaras untuk mencapai target pertumbuhan bisnis jangka panjang perusahaan. KUALIFIKASI 1. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 10 tahun di bidang Digital Marketing, Growth Marketing, Commercial Marketing, atau Business Growth, dengan minimal 5 tahun pada posisi General Manager, Head of Digital, Marketing Director, atau posisi eksekutif setara. 2. Memiliki rekam jejak dalam memimpin pertumbuhan bisnis berskala besar dengan pencapaian GMV, Revenue, Profitability, dan Market Share yang terukur. 3. Menguasai strategi Performance Marketing, Creative Strategy, Brand Management, KOL, Affiliate, CRM, Social Commerce, Marketplace, dan E-Commerce secara menyeluruh. 4. Memiliki kemampuan yang sangat kuat dalam Business Strategy, P&L Management, Data Analytics, Commercial Planning, dan Organizational Leadership. 5. Terbiasa memimpin organisasi lintas fungsi, mengelola anggaran pemasaran dalam skala besar, serta mengambil keputusan bisnis berdasarkan data dan KPI. 6. Berpengalaman di industri Beauty, FMCG, Consumer Goods, Retail, E-Commerce, atau perusahaan dengan pertumbuhan bisnis yang agresif akan menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.description: Membuat konten visual berupa Reels, Instagram Story, foto produk, dan dokumentasi aktivitas. Melakukan proses editing foto dan video agar sesuai dengan identitas brand. Mengembangkan ide dan konsep konten yang kreatif, menarik, dan relevan dengan target audiens. Mengikuti tren media sosial, terutama Instagram Reels, format video pendek, dan tren visual. Membuat konten yang mampu meningkatkan reach dan engagement Instagram. Berkolaborasi dengan tim kreatif, marketing, dan operasional. Menjaga konsistensi kualitas visual dan karakter brand Koffie Braga. Mengarsipkan dan mengelola file foto serta video dengan rapi. Kualifikasi: Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Content Creator, Videographer, Photographer, atau posisi sejenis. Mampu mengambil foto dan video dengan baik. Menguasai editing foto dan video. Memahami dasar-dasar komposisi, lighting, angle, dan storytelling visual. Memahami tren dan karakteristik konten Instagram. Kreatif, memiliki sense of visual yang baik, dan mampu menghasilkan ide-ide baru. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki portofolio menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia melakukan pengambilan konten di area Koffie Braga dan mengikuti kebutuhan produksi konten. Skill yang Dibutuhkan: Photography Videography Video Editing Editing foto Content Creation Storytelling Social Media Trend Awareness Nilai Tambah: Menguasai aplikasi seperti CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe Lightroom, Canva, atau aplikasi editing lainnya. Memahami dasar Instagram Insights dan performa konten. Memiliki pengalaman membuat konten untuk coffee shop, F&B, lifestyle, atau brand lokal.

jobs.title: Customer Service Manager
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari seorang Customer Service Manager yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Internet Mulia Untuk Negeri (NEXA) di Semarang, Jawa Tengah. Dalam posisi ini, Anda akan memainkan peran kunci dalam mengelola dan mengembangkan tim Layanan Pelanggan kami, serta memastikan pengalaman pelanggan yang luar biasa. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki track record yang terbukti dalam mengelola tim Layanan Pelanggan yang efektif, berorientasi pada hasil, dan berorientasi pada pelanggan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melakukan analisa dan perbaikan berkelanjutan terhadap customer journey di seluruh produk atau unit bisnis Menyusun dan mengeksekusi strategi jangka pendek & panjang untuk meningkatkan performa dan produktivitas tim Memastikan kualitas interaksi customer melalui monitoring dan evaluasi berkala Melakukan pengecekan terhadap hasil kerja tim (verifikasi, troubleshooting, dll) Menyusun dan menyampaikan briefing rutin serta memastikan update terkait promo & SOP tersampaikan dengan baik Mengatur jadwal dan shift tim operasional Mengelola seluruh channel layanan pelanggan (chat, call, email, dll) Memastikan semua request dan komplain ditangani sesuai dengan SLA dan SOP Menjadi titik eskalasi utama untuk kasus-kasus kompleks Menyusun laporan performa tim dan operasional, termasuk: Leads & conversion ke verifikasi,SLA (verifikasi, instalasi, komplain),Customer Satisfaction (CSAT),Customer Complaint Rate,Average First Response Time,Performance vendor (instalasi & troubleshooting). Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan Minimal S1 dari semua jurusan Pengalaman minimal 6 tahun di Customer Service / Customer Support , dengan 3 tahun di posisi managerial Berpengalaman memimpin tim operasional (CS, support, atau call center) Memiliki pemahaman kuat tentang customer journey, SLA, dan KPI customer service Terbiasa mengelola multi-channel support Memiliki kemampuan analisa data, mengidentifikasi tren, dan membuat keputusan berbasis data Berpengalaman dalam menangani eskalasi dan problem solving Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan leadership yang baik Pengalaman di industri B2C Internet Service Provider diutamakan Familiar dengan tools CRM, ticketing system, dan dashboard reporting Manfaat Utama Tunjangan yang menarik Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan kolaboratif dengan peluang pengembangan karier yang luas Budaya perusahaan yang mendukung keseimbangan kehidupan dan pekerjaan Akses ke pelatihan dan pengembangan profesional yang komprehensif Kesempatan untuk terlibat dalam inisiatif inovatif dan proyek yang menarik Tentang Kami NEXA adalah perusahaan teknologi terkemuka di Indonesia yang berdedikasi untuk memberdayakan masyarakat melalui solusi teknologi inovatif. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan dampak positif bagi komunitas dan lingkungan, sambil terus berinovasi dan tumbuh sebagai pemimpin di industri kami. Tim kami terdiri dari profesional berbakat yang termotivasi untuk membuat perbedaan, dan kami mendukung budaya kreativitas, kolaborasi, dan pertumbuhan pribadi. Lamar sekarang untuk kesempatan menantang dan menarik ini dan bergabung dengan tim kami di NEXA!

jobs.title: CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT OFFICER (CEO)
jobs.description: ATTENTION 1. WE ARE LOOKING ONLY FOR THE BEST. 2. WE PROVIDE LUCRATIVE BENEFITS FOR BEST CANDIDATES. 3. IF YOU ARE NOT QUALIFIED, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT OFFICER (CEO) THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS WILL BE CONDUCTED IN 3 PHASES: Interview with DIRECTOR Psycho test JOB OFFER JOB DESCRIPTION Perform daily MARKETING and SALES activities based on the INSTRUCTIONS and GUIDANCE from the CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT SUPERVISOR (CES), adhering to Key Performance Indicator and Measurement (KPIM). Direct Call & Customer Visit (Routine, Planned, and Systematic): Build good personal relationships with owners and decision-makers. Conduct routine sales activities and/or follow up on customer inquiries. Perform regular sales calls and reviews and explore new application opportunities through new projects. Collect relevant information to complete all necessary data in the CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM. Solve problems, handle complaints & claims. Introduce new products. Offer and promote promotional programs 2. Market Development: Search for new leads and prospective customers. Expand into new marketing areas. Build a detailed and functional customer database to support decision-making processes related to marketing activities. REQUIREMENTS Minimum education: Bachelor's degree (S1); fresh graduates are welcome, or a minimum of 2 years' experience in marketing/sales, preferably in sales related to printing products. Possess a POSITIVE MINDSET and align with the COMPANY'S VISION while performing daily tasks. Have strong PEOPLE SKILLS , persuasive communication abilities, and extensive knowledge (broad and helicopter point of view). Experienced in working with TEAMS and achieving TARGETS, with a results- and process-oriented mindset. Hold a valid SIM A and SIM C (driver’s licenses). BENEFITS Basic Salary KPIM Incentives Career Advancement Opportunities Domestic and International Business Trips PACKAGE OF THR BPJS Health and Employment Benefits Quarterly Team Celebrations Training & Seminars

1. WE ARE LOOKING ONLY FOR THE BEST.

CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT OFFICER (CEO)

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS WILL BE CONDUCTED IN 3 PHASES:

  1. Interview with DIRECTOR

  2. Psycho test

  3. JOB OFFER

JOB DESCRIPTION

Perform daily MARKETING and SALES activities based on the INSTRUCTIONS and GUIDANCE from the CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT SUPERVISOR (CES), adhering to Key Performance Indicator and Measurement (KPIM).

  1. Direct Call & Customer Visit (Routine, Planned, and Systematic):

  • Build good personal relationships with owners and decision-makers.

  • Conduct routine sales activities and/or follow up on customer inquiries.

  • Perform regular sales calls and reviews and explore new application opportunities through new projects.

  • Collect relevant information to complete all necessary data in the CUSTOMER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM.

  • Solve problems, handle complaints & claims.

  • Introduce new products.

  • Offer and promote promotional programs

2. Market Development:

  • Search for new leads and prospective customers.

  • Expand into new marketing areas.

  • Build a detailed and functional customer database to support decision-making processes related to marketing activities.

  • Minimum education: Bachelor's degree (S1); fresh graduates are welcome, or a minimum of 2 years' experience in marketing/sales, preferably in sales related to printing products.

  • Possess a POSITIVE MINDSET and align with the COMPANY'S VISION while performing daily tasks.

  • Have strong PEOPLE SKILLS, persuasive communication abilities, and extensive knowledge (broad and helicopter point of view).

  • Experienced in working with TEAMS and achieving TARGETS, with a results- and process-oriented mindset.

  • Hold a valid SIM A and SIM C (driver’s licenses).

BENEFITS

  • Basic Salary

  • KPIM Incentives

  • Career Advancement Opportunities

  • Domestic and International Business Trips

  • PACKAGE OF THR

  • BPJS Health and Employment Benefits

  • Quarterly Team Celebrations

jobs.title: Research & Development Staff
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Research and Development Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Industri, Teknik Tekstil, Tata Busana, Manajemen Industri, atau jurusan lain yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun di bidang Research & Development, Product Development, IE (Industrial Engineering), atau Garment Manufacturing menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami proses produksi garmen mulai dari pengembangan sampel, cutting, sewing, finishing, hingga packing. Memahami karakteristik kain, aksesori (trim), dan teknik konstruksi pakaian. Mampu melakukan analisis efisiensi proses produksi, konsumsi bahan baku, dan produktivitas. Menguasai Microsoft Office, terutama Excel untuk pengolahan data dan analisis. Memiliki kemampuan membuat SOP, Work Instruction (WI), dan standar proses kerja. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, serta berpikir inovatif untuk pengembangan produk dan proses. Mampu bekerja sama dengan tim Merchandising, PPIC, Produksi, Quality, dan Purchasing. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, teliti, disiplin, dan berorientasi pada target. Job Description Research and Development Melakukan penelitian dan pengembangan terhadap produk garmen sesuai kebutuhan pelanggan dan tren pasar. Mengembangkan metode kerja yang lebih efektif dan efisien untuk meningkatkan produktivitas produksi. Melakukan analisis terhadap proses produksi guna mengidentifikasi potensi peningkatan kualitas, efisiensi biaya, dan pengurangan waste. Menyusun standar operasional prosedur (SOP), Work Instruction (WI), dan standar kualitas untuk proses produksi. Melakukan trial atau uji coba material, pola, metode jahit, mesin, serta proses produksi sebelum diterapkan secara massal. Menganalisis penggunaan bahan baku (fabric dan trims) untuk meningkatkan efisiensi konsumsi material. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Merchandising, Sample Room, PPIC, Produksi, Quality Control, dan Purchasing dalam proses pengembangan produk baru. Melakukan evaluasi terhadap hasil trial serta memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan proses maupun produk. Melakukan benchmarking terhadap teknologi, mesin, material, dan metode produksi terbaru di industri garmen. Menyusun laporan hasil penelitian, pengembangan, dan implementasi perbaikan proses kepada manajemen. Mengawal implementasi hasil pengembangan hingga mencapai standar kualitas, biaya, dan waktu produksi yang telah ditetapkan. Mendukung program continuous improvement, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, dan peningkatan produktivitas di area produksi.

jobs.title: Partner Growth & Enablement Executive
jobs.description: WE ARE "URGENTLY" OPENING/RECEIVING APPLICATIONS TO JOIN US! Your daily operations will be conducted at our new, modern office in BSD . As our Partner Growth & Enablement Executive for Implementing Partners, you’ll be the main bridge between our company and our ecosystem of ERP partners. Your mission is to help them grow (sales revenue, product knowledge, and software implementations), stay aligned with our standards/rules, and deliver successful ERP projects for their clients. You’ll work closely with partners to ensure they’re meeting their KPIs, for examples: number of new users acquired. On top of that, supported in their business goals, and equipped with the right tools to thrive — all while maintaining strong, strategic relationships built on trust and performance. If you enjoy helping others succeed while driving business results, this role is made for you. RESPONSIBILITIES: Drive sales growth through implementing partners , ensuring they meet or exceed assigned revenue targets and KPIs. Build and execute joint business plans with each partner — aligning on goals, sales strategies, and target markets. Regularly review partner pipelines, identify opportunities, and provide guidance to accelerate deal closures. Actively join partners in customer meetings, sales calls, demos, and other activities to support co-selling, product positioning, and negotiation with end clients.” Monitor and report on partner sales performance, forecast accuracy, and activity levels. Collaborate with the Partner Manager and internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical) to enable and empower partners for success. Maintain high standards of partner performance — balancing support and accountability. Represent the voice of partners internally, ensuring they have the right tools and resources to grow. REQUIREMENTS: MUST HAVE Min. Bachelor degree or higher Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia 2 - 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or channel/partner management Strong understanding of business processes (finance, sales, inventory, manufacturing, etc.) and variety of business models (service companies, retail companies) Proven track record in driving revenue and growth through parners or resellers Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Analytical and KPI-driven mindset — comfortable working with numbers, forecasts, and performance dashboards. Proactive and organized, with a high sense of ownership and accountability. Highly proactive, result-oriented , and comfortable owning sales targets. NICE TO HAVE Understanding of ERP implementation lifecycles and common partner challenges Ability to lead workshops or training session. Immediate availability

jobs.title: SPV Warehouse
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan seluruh aktivitas operasional gudang (inbound, storage, outbound). Memastikan penerimaan, penyimpanan, dan pengiriman barang berjalan sesuai prosedur. Mengontrol akurasi stok melalui stock opname dan rekonsiliasi data. Mengelola tata letak gudang agar penyimpanan lebih efektif dan efisien. Memastikan penerapan FIFO/FEFO sesuai jenis material. Mengawasi kinerja tim warehouse serta melakukan pembinaan dan evaluasi. Berkoordinasi dengan PPIC, Purchasing, Produksi, dan departemen terkait. Memastikan penerapan K3, 5R, dan standar operasional di area gudang. Menyusun laporan operasional gudang secara berkala. Melakukan perbaikan proses (continuous improvement) untuk meningkatkan produktivitas gudang. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Logistik, Teknik Industri, Manajemen, atau jurusan terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang Warehouse, dengan minimal 1 tahun sebagai Supervisor. Memahami sistem manajemen pergudangan, inventory control, dan stock opname. Memahami penerapan FIFO/FEFO serta administrasi keluar masuk barang. Terbiasa menggunakan Microsoft Excel dan sistem ERP/WMS menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan leadership, komunikasi, analisis, dan problem solving yang baik. Mampu bekerja dengan target, teliti, serta memiliki kemampuan mengelola tim. Bersedia ditempatkan di Jasem, Mojokerto.

jobs.title: INTERNAL AUDIT
jobs.description: Job Description: Melakukan pemeriksaan dan evaluasi terhadap proses operasional dan administrasi perusahaan. Mengidentifikasi potensi risiko, kesalahan, ketidaksesuaian, dan penyimpangan dalam proses kerja. Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap transaksi, dokumen, stok, dan laporan yang berkaitan dengan kegiatan operasional perusahaan. Membuat laporan hasil audit dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan kepada pihak terkait. Melakukan monitoring dan tindak lanjut terhadap hasil temuan audit untuk memastikan perbaikan telah dilakukan. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Akuntansi, Manajemen, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Internal Audit, Audit, Finance, atau Accounting. Memahami proses audit, pengendalian internal, dan prosedur operasional perusahaan. Teliti, analitis, kritis, dan memiliki kemampuan problem solving yang baik. jobs.description: About the role PT Queen's Tandoor is seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead our marketing initiatives and drive brand growth. Based in Kuta, Bali , this is a full-time position that offers a strategic opportunity to shape the marketing direction of a dynamic hospitality business. This role is central to building brand awareness, driving customer engagement, and achieving our business objectives in a competitive market. What you'll be doing Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives and target market needs Manage marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels, including social media, email marketing, and advertising Oversee brand positioning and ensure consistency across all marketing materials and communications Monitor and analyse marketing performance metrics, providing regular reports and insights to senior management Collaborate with internal teams to coordinate promotional activities, events, and customer engagement initiatives Manage the marketing budget effectively, maximising return on investment whilst maintaining cost efficiency Lead research on market trends, competitor activity, and customer preferences to inform strategic planning Develop and maintain relationships with external partners, agencies, and media contacts Create and oversee content strategy for all marketing channels to enhance brand presence Supervise and mentor junior marketing staff, fostering professional development within the team What we're looking for Minimum 3-5 years of marketing management experience in the hospitality, food and beverage, or related industry Proven track record of developing and implementing successful marketing strategies that drive business results Strong knowledge of digital marketing platforms, social media management, and analytics tools Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Indonesian language skills are advantageous Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously whilst meeting tight deadlines Creative thinking combined with data-driven decision-making capabilities Strong analytical skills with proficiency in marketing metrics and performance reporting Experience managing marketing budgets and allocating resources effectively Excellent leadership and team management abilities Knowledge of the Bali market and tourism industry is preferred Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or related field What we offer PT Queen's Tandoor is committed to creating a supportive and rewarding workplace. We offer competitive compensation packages, professional development opportunities, and ongoing training to enhance your skills and career growth. Our team benefits from a collaborative working environment, performance-based incentives, and the opportunity to work in one of Bali's most vibrant locations. We value our employees' wellbeing and provide support to ensure a healthy work-life balance. About us PT Queen's Tandoor is a respected hospitality establishment in Kuta, Bali, dedicated to delivering exceptional dining experiences through authentic cuisine and outstanding customer service. Our mission is to create memorable moments for our guests whilst maintaining high standards of quality and professionalism. We pride ourselves on our team's passion, creativity, and commitment to excellence. Our company culture emphasises innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, making us an exciting place to build a meaningful career in the hospitality and food and beverage sector. Apply now If you are a dynamic marketing professional with a passion for the hospitality industry and a proven ability to drive results, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your CV, cover letter, and any relevant portfolio materials to join our team at PT Queen's Tandoor.

jobs.title: BESS Engineer
jobs.description: Nippon Koei Energy Solutions Introduction Our holding company, ID&E Holdings Co., Ltd. (ID&E), was officially established on 3 July 2023. The "Consulting Business," "Urban & Spatial Development Business," and "Energy Business," which were previously the business divisions of Nippon Koei Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as NK) which is Japan’s No.1 International Engineering Consultants in terms of size and turnover for consulting services, became independent as separate corporate organizations. Among these, Nippon Koei Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as NKES) commenced its operations on 1 October 2023, drawing on the foundations of NK’s “DNA”, the energy management, manufacturing, construction & installation, and electro-mechanical consulting fields have been retained; and we continue to provide one-stop services pertaining to energy. Work Environment We are looking for a BESS Engineer to support efficiently the expansion of our services. You will lead and oversee the engineering and technical aspects of battery energy storage system projects. This role is accountable for the review of project plans and specifications for design accuracy, constructability, conformance to regulatory agency requirements and productivity improvement. You will evolve in an international environment and work in close coordination with other teams throughout the company in order to deliver projects at the highest quality standards. Missions You will report to the Product Manager. Prepares or assists in the conceptual sizing of BESS and supports project reporting. Evaluates, selects, and applies standard electrical engineering methods, procedures, and criteria to prepare/review conceptual studies, design criteria and specifications, sizing calculations, and layout engineering of BESS and its relation to other generation and/or transmission equipment. Coordinates internal project engineering efforts with other engineering disciplines. Provides technical assistance and interacts with project stakeholders, including customers, EPC contractors, and vendors. Assists the project execution team in identifying and complying with agreed project standards and requirements, specifically for BESS, by reviewing designs, construction methods, quality plans/procedures, commissioning procedures, and test results. Battery and inverter sizing and analysis. Develop expertise in the central aspects and characteristics of current battery technologies, linking them to battery parameters. Conduct techno-commercial analyses of various energy storage technologie. Perform BESS modeling in system studies for renewable energy systems integrating BESS. Oversee and review technical documents provided by vendors. Provide technical support for the deployment of BESS solutions. Contribute to engineering work planning and control methods. Ensure alignment with construction practices and economic considerations Profile We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, or related fields. Minimum of 5 years of experience in BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems) engineering or a related field. Electrical design and optimization of battery-based energy storage systems. Previous experience as a PMC (Project Management Consultant)is desirable. Solid knowledge of engineering practices, construction economics, and leadership skills. Solid communication skills in English and Bahasa. Only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

Our holding company, ID&E Holdings Co., Ltd. (ID&E), was officially established on 3 July 2023. The \"Consulting Business,\" \"Urban & Spatial Development Business,\" and \"Energy Business,\" which were previously the business divisions of Nippon Koei Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as NK) which is Japan’s No.1 International Engineering Consultants in terms of size and turnover for consulting services, became independent as separate corporate organizations. Among these, Nippon Koei Energy Solutions Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as NKES) commenced its operations on 1 October 2023, drawing on the foundations of NK’s “DNA”, the energy management, manufacturing, construction & installation, and electro-mechanical consulting fields have been retained; and we continue to provide one-stop services pertaining to energy.

Work Environment

We are looking for a BESS Engineer to support efficiently the expansion of our services. You will lead and oversee the engineering and technical aspects of battery energy storage system projects. This role is accountable for the review of project plans and specifications for design accuracy, constructability, conformance to regulatory agency requirements and productivity improvement. You will evolve in an international environment and work in close coordination with other teams throughout the company in order to deliver projects at the highest quality standards.

Missions

  • You will report to the Product Manager.

  • Prepares or assists in the conceptual sizing of BESS and supports project reporting.

  • Evaluates, selects, and applies standard electrical engineering methods, procedures, and criteria to prepare/review conceptual studies, design criteria and specifications, sizing calculations, and layout engineering of BESS and its relation to other generation and/or transmission equipment.

  • Coordinates internal project engineering efforts with other engineering disciplines.

  • Provides technical assistance and interacts with project stakeholders, including customers, EPC contractors, and vendors.

  • Assists the project execution team in identifying and complying with agreed project standards and requirements, specifically for BESS, by reviewing designs, construction methods, quality plans/procedures, commissioning procedures, and test results.

  • Battery and inverter sizing and analysis.

  • Develop expertise in the central aspects and characteristics of current battery technologies, linking them to battery parameters.

  • Conduct techno-commercial analyses of various energy storage technologie.

  • Perform BESS modeling in system studies for renewable energy systems integrating BESS.

  • Oversee and review technical documents provided by vendors.

  • Provide technical support for the deployment of BESS solutions.

  • Contribute to engineering work planning and control methods.

  • Ensure alignment with construction practices and economic considerations

Profile

We are looking for talented and motivated people to create the future of energy. Join a rewarding and flexible work environment that encourages innovation and creativity and help us meet the energy challenges of today and tomorrow.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, or related fields.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems) engineering or a related field.

  • Electrical design and optimization of battery-based energy storage systems.

  • Previous experience as a PMC (Project Management Consultant)is desirable.

  • Solid knowledge of engineering practices, construction economics, and leadership skills.

  • Solid communication skills in English and Bahasa.

Only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

Smallholder & Sustainability Officer (ICS Assistant)


📍 Placement: North Labuhanbatu, North Sumatera

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate and driven ICS Assistant to support our smallholder partnership and sustainability programs. In this role, you will work closely with farmers, plantation operations, and sustainability teams to improve plantation productivity, strengthen partnerships, and support ISPO/RSPO certification compliance.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for professionals who are passionate about sustainable agriculture and palm oil plantation management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and training to smallholder farmers on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP).

  • Monitor plantation performance and support productivity improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain and update farmer and land databases.

  • Support the implementation of sustainability programs and certification requirements (ISPO & RSPO).

  • Conduct field visits and prepare activity reports.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure successful partnership programs.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture, Agronomy, Plantation, or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in palm oil plantation operations.

  • Strong understanding of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP).

  • Familiarity with ISPO and RSPO standards is highly preferred.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

jobs.title: Sales Consultant
jobs.description: Company Description Vanaya&Co. is a Jakarta-based organization focused on delivering innovative, customer-centered solutions. The company operates in a collaborative environment where data-driven decision-making and practical consulting approaches are valued. Team members work closely with clients to understand their needs and provide tailored strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. Vanaya&Co. emphasizes continuous learning, professional growth, and integrity in every client engagement. Role Description The Sales Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in Jakarta, Indonesia. This role involves engaging prospective and existing clients, understanding their business needs, and presenting appropriate solutions and services from Vanaya&Co.’s portfolio. The Sales Consultant will conduct sales meetings and presentations, prepare proposals, follow up on leads, negotiate terms, and manage the sales pipeline to achieve revenue targets. Daily responsibilities include maintaining strong customer relationships, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, and collaborating with internal teams to refine offerings and improve service delivery. The role also requires accurate reporting of sales activities, market insights, and client feedback to support business planning. Qualifications Strong Sales Consulting skills with experience in identifying client needs, proposing solutions, and driving deal closure. Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills to build trust, manage expectations, and maintain long-term client relationships. Excellent Communication skills, including clear presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities. Consulting skills to analyze client challenges, interpret data, and recommend practical, value-driven strategies. Proven experience in B2B sales or consulting, preferably in professional services or related industries. Ability to work on-site in Jakarta, manage multiple client engagements, and meet defined sales targets. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with proficiency in CRM tools and basic office software. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Fluency in English and Indonesian, with the ability to prepare clear written proposals and conduct professional meetings.

jobs.title: Trend Research Internship
jobs.description: PT Waas Corp Indonesia merupakan holding company yang berdedikasi untuk menciptakan pengalaman kerja yang luar biasa, inovatif, dan solusi yang berorientasi pada hasil. Dengan tim yang solid dan berdedikasi, kami terus berkembang di lingkungan bisnis yang bergerak secara dinamis. Saat ini kami sedang mencari Trend Research Internship yang kreatif, inovatif, dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan Perusahaan kami. Tipe Internship: Unpaid Internship. Work From Office (WFO). Komitmen untuk magang selama periode 6 bulan. Tanggung Jawab Utama: Melakukan riset pasar dan pesaing. Memantau perilaku konsumen dan tren industri. Mengidentifikasi tren digital dan media sosial yang sedang berkembang. Mengumpulkan dan mengorganisir data riset. Menyusun laporan analisis tren. Mempresentasikan temuan riset kepada tim pemasaran. Mendukung pengembangan ide kampanye dengan memanfaatkan wawasan dari riset. Memantau produk dan konten yang viral. Membantu tim produk dan branding dengan wawasan pasar. Mengelola basis data riset. Kualifikasi: Mahasiswa aktif atau lulusan baru dari jurusan Pemasaran, Bisnis, Statistik, Ekonomi, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait. Kemampuan berpikir analitis yang kuat. Kemampuan riset daring yang sangat baik. Terbiasa menggunakan Google Trends dan alat pemantauan media sosial. Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel dan Google Sheets. Kemampuan menginterpretasikan data. Perhatian terhadap detail. Rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi terhadap perilaku konsumen. Kemampuan presentasi yang baik.

jobs.title: Accounting Staff
jobs.description: Responsibilities: Mencatat dan memelihara data transaksi keuangan yang akurat dalam sistem akuntansi. Menyiapkan, memantau, dan merekonsiliasi laporan keuangan, termasuk jadwal amortisasi dan depresiasi, jurnal reklasifikasi, jurnal akrual, dan jurnal penyesuaian. Meninjau dan memantau transaksi keuangan untuk memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar akuntansi yang berlaku dan kebijakan perusahaan. Menyiapkan dan mengawasi laporan beban operasional, Harga Pokok Penjualan (HPP/COGS), laporan penjualan, dan laporan keuangan proyek. Memantau jadwal umur piutang (*aging schedule*) dan saldo terutang untuk memastikan penyelesaian tepat waktu dan pencapaian target perusahaan. Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis data perencanaan serta penggunaan anggaran di seluruh organisasi. Mendukung dan mengoordinasikan audit keuangan eksternal dan internal, serta audit dan pemeriksaan pajak. Memastikan akurasi, kelengkapan, dan validitas data keuangan di seluruh entitas dalam grup perusahaan. Membantu kegiatan penutupan buku bulanan, termasuk rekonsiliasi akun dan tinjauan keuangan yang diminta oleh Kepala Departemen. Menyiapkan dokumentasi pendukung dan data keuangan untuk proses penganggaran dan kebutuhan terkait pajak, termasuk tinjauan tahun sebelumnya. Bekerja sama dengan tim dan departemen lintas fungsi untuk meninjau, menganalisis, dan merekonsiliasi transaksi keuangan. Meninjau proses pencatatan keuangan dan memberikan rekomendasi kepada departemen lain untuk meningkatkan akurasi akuntansi dan kepatuhan. Qualification: Gelar Sarjana (S1) Akuntansi. Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Accountant (Mandatory) Memiliki pengetahuan yang kuat mengenai Standar Akuntansi Keuangan (PSAK) Indonesia, Prinsip Akuntansi, Manajemen Biaya, Audit, Kepatuhan, dan Pelaporan Keuangan. Kemahiran tingkat lanjut dalam penggunaan Microsoft Excel dan perangkat lunak pelaporan keuangan. Wajib memiliki pengalaman praktis menggunakan Odoo ERP.

jobs.title: General Manager
jobs.description: Job Description : Bertanggung jawab penuh atas keseluruhan operasional mall yang dipimpin, pertumbuhan bisnis, serta memastikan sinergi yang kuat antar departemen. Merumuskan dan mengeksekusi strategi jangka panjang untuk meningkatkan profitabilitas mall, okupansi tenant , dan jumlah pengunjung. Memastikan standar pelayanan (Service Excellence) terjaga untuk meningkatkan indeks kepuasan pengunjung dan mempertahankan retensi tenants. Mengawasi performa finansial mall bersama, termasuk penyusunan budget tahunan, kontrol biaya operasional dan optimalisasi profit. Mengarahkan dan merancang strategi promosi, event, digital marketing, serta negosiasi kerja sama dengan tenants . Memastikan proses pengadaan barang dan jasa berjalan efisien, transparan, dan sesuai dengan standar kualitas serta budget perusahaan. Menyusun rencana anggaran operasinal tahunan dan menjaga pengeluaran agar tetap efisien tanpa mengurangi kualitas layanan. Membina, mengevaluasi, dan mengembangkan kapabilitas tim manajerial di bawahnya untuk mencapai target KPI yang ditetapkan. Requirements: Pendidikan minimal Minimal S1 semua jurusan (diutamakan Manajemen Bisnis, Akuntansi/Keuangan, Pemasaran) Berpengalaman minimal 5 tahun di industri pusat perbelanjaan dan minimal 3 tahun di posisi manajerial senior Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam memimpin tim lintas fungsi (khususnya Keuangan, Pemasaran, Marketing, dan Engineering Memahami analisis laporan keuangan (P&L), manajemen aset, strategi retail marketing, serta hukum/regulasi terkait pengelolaan properti komersial Kepemimpinan yang kuat, kemampuan pemecahan masalah (crisis management), dan berorientasi pada detail. Visioner, berintegritas tinggi, mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan, dan memiliki kemampuan problem-solving yang cepat dan tepat Bersedia bekerja dengan jadwal kerja yang fleksibel Bersedia ditempatkan di Magelang

Strong sense of responsibility, good presentation, communication skills, and applicable for a long term travel time in different places.

jobs.title: SALES GENERAL TRADE (GT) – Jakarta & Jawa Tengah (Home Base: Jakarta)
jobs.description: Job Responsibilities • Mengelola dan mengembangkan penjualan produk perusahaan melalui channel General Trade, termasuk toko listrik, toko bangunan, toko tradisional, grosir, dan distributor. • Mencapai target penjualan, distribusi, serta pelaksanaan program promosi sesuai KPI yang ditetapkan perusahaan. • Melakukan kunjungan rutin ke pelanggan dan memastikan coverage area berjalan secara optimal. • Mengidentifikasi peluang pasar serta membuka outlet dan pelanggan baru untuk memperluas jaringan distribusi. • Membangun dan menjaga hubungan bisnis yang kuat dengan distributor, grosir, dan pelanggan retail. • Melakukan negosiasi program penjualan, display produk, dan aktivitas promosi di outlet. • Memantau aktivitas kompetitor, perkembangan pasar, harga, serta tren penjualan untuk mendukung strategi bisnis. • Menyusun laporan penjualan, aktivitas kunjungan, dan perkembangan pasar secara berkala dan akurat. • Berkoordinasi dengan tim internal terkait proses pemesanan, pengiriman, stok, dan penagihan pelanggan. • Memastikan ketersediaan produk dan pencapaian distribusi yang optimal di area tanggung jawab. Qualifications • Pendidikan minimal S1 dari berbagai jurusan. • Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Sales General Trade (GT). • Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman di industri Electrical, Lighting, Building Material, FMCG, atau Consumer Goods. • Memiliki jaringan pelanggan General Trade yang kuat di area DKI Jakarta dan/atau Jawa Tengah menjadi nilai tambah. • Memahami sistem distribusi melalui distributor, grosir, dan retail tradisional. • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, presentasi, dan selling yang baik. • Berorientasi pada target, hasil, dan pertumbuhan penjualan. • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. • Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas secara rutin sesuai kebutuhan area kerja. • Memiliki SIM C dan kendaraan pribadi. • Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel serta aplikasi pelaporan penjualan. • Bersedia ditempatkan dengan home base di DKI Jakarta. Candidate Profile We're Looking For • Memiliki mentalitas hunter dan terbiasa melakukan akuisisi pelanggan baru. • Proaktif, aktif di lapangan, dan memiliki kemampuan membangun pasar dari nol. • Terbiasa bekerja dengan target penjualan bulanan dan KPI yang terukur. • Memiliki integritas, disiplin, dan tanggung jawab yang tinggi. • Mampu membangun hubungan bisnis jangka panjang dengan distributor maupun pelanggan retail. • Memiliki semangat tinggi untuk berkembang dan berkontribusi terhadap pertumbuhan bisnis perusahaan. Benefits • Gaji pokok yang kompetitif. • Insentif penjualan tanpa batas berdasarkan pencapaian kinerja. • Tunjangan perjalanan dan komunikasi. • BPJS Ketenagakerjaan. • Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pertumbuhan bersama perusahaan yang terus berkembang.

About the role

We are seeking a talented and enthusiastic Marketing Executive to join PT Queen's Tandoor, a dynamic hospitality business based in Kuta, Bali. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in driving our brand visibility, customer engagement and revenue growth through strategic marketing communications and promotional initiatives. As a Marketing Executive, you will be instrumental in developing and executing marketing campaigns that resonate with our target audience and strengthen our market position in the competitive hospitality sector. This role offers the opportunity to work in a vibrant location whilst contributing to the success of a thriving restaurant business.

Key responsibilities

  1. Develop, plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels to promote PT Queen's Tandoor's dining experiences and services

  2. Create engaging marketing content including social media posts, email newsletters, promotional materials and advertisements that align with brand messaging

  3. Manage and optimise the company's social media presence across multiple platforms, including content scheduling, community engagement and performance monitoring

  4. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for brand differentiation and market positioning

  5. Collaborate with restaurant management and operations teams to ensure marketing initiatives support business objectives and customer acquisition targets

  6. Coordinate promotional events, special offers and seasonal campaigns to drive customer traffic and loyalty

  7. Monitor and analyse marketing performance metrics and campaign effectiveness, providing regular reports and recommendations for improvement

  8. Build and maintain relationships with external partners, vendors and media contacts to support marketing activities

  9. Support brand consistency across all customer touchpoints and marketing communications materials


What we're looking for

  1. Proven experience in marketing or marketing communications, ideally within the hospitality, food and beverage or retail sector

  2. Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including social media, email marketing and online advertising platforms

  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to create compelling marketing messages and content

  4. Proficiency in using marketing tools and software, such as social media management platforms, design software and analytics tools

  5. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously whilst maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines

  6. Creative thinking with the ability to develop innovative marketing ideas and campaigns that capture audience attention

  7. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven marketing decisions

  8. Fluency in English and Indonesian is essential; additional languages are advantageous

  9. Knowledge of the Bali tourism market and local consumer behaviour is highly desirable

  10. A passion for the hospitality industry and understanding of customer service excellence


What we offer

  1. Competitive salary package commensurate with experience and qualifications

  2. Full-time employment with job security and career development opportunities within a growing hospitality business

  3. The opportunity to work in the vibrant location of Kuta, Bali, with exposure to a diverse and international customer base

  4. A collaborative and creative work environment where your ideas are valued and encouraged

  5. Staff benefits including meal discounts and access to company facilities

  6. Professional development opportunities and support for skill enhancement in marketing and communications

  7. Work-life balance initiatives that recognise the importance of employee wellbeing


About us

PT Queen's Tandoor is a respected hospitality business located in Kuta, Bali, specialising in authentic cuisine and dining experiences. We are committed to delivering exceptional customer service, high-quality food and a welcoming atmosphere that attracts both local and international guests. Our mission is to become a premier destination for authentic dining in Bali, and we value creativity, teamwork and a passion for hospitality. We pride ourselves on creating memorable experiences for our customers and fostering a supportive work environment where our team members can thrive and grow their careers.

Apply now

If you are a motivated marketing professional with a passion for the hospitality industry and the drive to make an impact, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and examples of marketing work you have undertaken to our recruitment team. Join PT Queen's Tandoor and help us reach new in Bali's competitive hospitality market.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. Cambium Quality Curved' mencari seorang Office Manager yang berpengalaman dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Kelapa Gading, Jakarta Raya. Sebagai Office Manager, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam mengelola operasional perkantoran sehari-hari, memastikan lingkungan kerja yang efisien, produktif, dan profesional. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang proaktif, memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan yang baik, dan mampu mengoordinasikan berbagai aspek administratif. Jabatan ini adalah posisi fulltime yang menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkontribusi secara signifikan dalam kesuksesan operasional perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola operasional perkantoran harian, termasuk koordinasi fasilitas, pemeliharaan, dan kebersihan ruang kerja. Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan administrasi perkantoran, termasuk pengelolaan dokumen, arsip, dan sistem filing yang terorganisir. Mengelola anggaran perkantoran dan melakukan procurement barang-barang kantor dengan efisien dan cost-effective. Mengkoordinasikan jadwal rapat, perjalanan bisnis, dan acara perusahaan dengan detail yang teliti. Mengelola hubungan dengan vendor, supplier, dan penyedia layanan kantor untuk memastikan kualitas layanan terbaik. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap kebijakan perusahaan dan peraturan keselamatan kerja di lingkungan perkantoran. Menangani komunikasi internal dan eksternal, serta melayani sebagai titik kontak utama untuk berbagai keperluan administratif. Merekrut, melatih, dan mengawasi staf administratif dan support services dengan efektif. Mempersiapkan laporan dan dokumentasi manajemen perkantoran untuk kepemimpinan senior. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal Diploma (D3) dalam Manajemen Perkantoran, Administrasi Bisnis, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman sebagai Office Manager atau dalam posisi manajemen perkantoran yang serupa. Memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang operasional dan manajemen perkantoran modern. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia dan English. Keterampilan kepemimpinan yang kuat dengan kemampuan mengelola dan memotivasi tim. Mahir dalam penggunaan software Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) dan sistem manajemen digital lainnya. Kemampuan problem-solving yang excellent dan attention to detail yang tinggi. Pengalaman dalam manajemen anggaran dan procurement adalah nilai tambah. Pemahaman tentang keselamatan kerja dan regulasi ketenagakerjaan di Indonesia. Kemampuan multitasking dan dapat bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat. Tentang Kami PT. Cambium Quality Curved' adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi berkualitas tinggi dengan standar profesional yang terbaik. Kami percaya bahwa operasional yang terkelola dengan baik adalah fondasi dari kesuksesan bisnis. Tim kami terdiri dari profesional yang berdedikasi dan inovatif dalam bidangnya masing-masing. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung pertumbuhan karyawan, mendorong kolaborasi, dan menghargai kontribusi setiap anggota tim. Dengan fokus pada kualitas dan efisiensi, kami terus berkembang dan membangun reputasi yang solid di industri kami. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kriteria di atas dan tertarik untuk menjadi bagian dari tim kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Kirimkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio pengalaman Anda kepada tim Human Resources kami. Kami menantikan kesempatan untuk mengenal Anda lebih baik dan mempertimbangkan Anda untuk posisi yang menarik ini.

Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, or related field (or equivalent professional experience). Minimum 1 years of experience in product or industrial design (experience in F&B, lifestyle, or retail industries is a strong plus). Strong portfolio showcasing both product/packaging development and graphic/visual design capabilities. Proficient in design and prototyping software (Adobe Creative Suite, CAD, Rhino, SolidWorks, or similar). Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Able to speak English Responsibilities: Design and develop packaging, product containers, and related F&B collateral with a strong focus on sustainability, usability, and cost-effectiveness. Collaborate with the graphic design, marketing, and operations teams to translate creative concepts into functional, manufacturable products. Research and recommend sustainable materials, printing methods, and production techniques suitable for F&B packaging and merchandising. Create technical drawings, dielines, and prototypes in collaboration with suppliers and vendors. BukuWarung sedang mencari Sales Canvassing (Merchant Success Executive) atau Sales TO EDC yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. 

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang erat dengan pedagang yang ditugaskan, bertindak sebagai mitra strategis untuk membantu mereka mencapai tujuan bisnis

  • Memahami kebutuhan, tantangan, dan peluang pedagang, lalu menyediakan solusi dan rekomendasi yang disesuaikan

  • Memberikan pelatihan, dukungan, dan bimbingan untuk memastikan pedagang dapat dengan mudah menggunakan produk dan layanan kami

  • Mengidentifikasi peluang penjualan silang dan lintas penjualan, lalu mengembangkan strategi untuk mendorong pertumbuhan

  • Menganalisis data dan metrik kunci untuk mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan, lalu mengembangkan rencana tindakan yang selaras

  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim lain seperti pemasaran, layanan pelanggan, dan pengembangan produk untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik bagi pedagang

Keterampilan dan Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

  • Min Pendidikan SMA (Punya pengalaman di sales) Gelar sarjana dalam bidang Bisnis, Pemasaran, atau bidang terkait

  • Minimal 1 tahun pengalaman dalam peran Keberhasilan Pelanggan, Manajemen Akun, atau bidang serupa di industri teknologi/e-commerce

  • Pemahaman yang mendalam tentang solusi pembayaran digital, teknologi e-commerce, dan tren industri

  • Kemampuan untuk memahami kebutuhan dan tantangan pedagang serta mengembangkan solusi yang disesuaikan

  • Keterampilan komunikasi dan presentasi yang sangat baik, dengan kemampuan untuk berinteraksi dengan pemangku kepentingan di semua tingkatan

  • Berorientasi pada hasil, berpikir kreatif, dan kemampuan memecahkan masalah yang kuat

  • Kemampuan untuk bekerja secara efektif dalam lingkungan yang bergerak cepat dan multitasking

Manfaat Bekerja di Tech Service

  • Gaji Pokok, Allowance (Pulsa + Transport), BPJS Kesehatan dan Ketenagakerjaan

  • Kesempatan untuk berkembang secara profesional melalui pelatihan dan program pengembangan karier

  • Lingkungan kerja yang kolaboratif, inovatif, dan berpusat pada karyawan

  • Budaya yang mendorong keseimbangan kehidupan-kerja, termasuk fleksibilitas jam kerja

  • Akses ke fasilitas dan layanan yang dirancang untuk mendukung kesejahteraan karyawan
    Tertarik untuk bergabung dengan kami? Lamar sekarang untuk peran ini yang menarik dan penuh tantangan.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Build, configure, and maintain network monitoring systems like Zabbix or Nagios independently to monitor all active company devices. Act as the primary PIC working alongside the IT Support team to identify, isolate, and handle technical network disturbances. Perform comprehensive optimization and tuning of all network rules including firewall rules, ACL, and routing across a multi-vendor ecosystem including Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, FS, and HPE. Provide technical data, evidence documents, and execute direct fixes for ISO 27001, internal, and external audit findings. Create weekly project progress reports, network topology diagrams, IPAM, and runbooks while conducting knowledge transfer sessions. Follow the company working hours from 8 AM to 5 PM, performing periodic and incidental visits to the Biznet Technovillage Data Center.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description: Serve as a facilitator providing dedicated support to the Scrum Team including Product Owners, Development Teams, and Stakeholders. Monitor the Scrum Team throughout agile, adaptive, transparent, and professional software development processes. Implement Scrum Core Values within the team encompassing Courage, Focus, Openness, Respect, and Commitment. Shield the Development Team's focus from external interventions and impediments. Escalate issues and drive proactive solutions for obstacles encountered by the Development Team. Collaborate with the Product Owner to guarantee that development activities align with agreed Sprint Goals. Coordinate with the Product Owner to prioritize Product Backlogs according to business value and urgency levels. Supervise the Development Team during the execution of all Scrum Ceremonies. Analyze problems proactively to help the team discover both short-term and long-term resolutions. Identify opportunities and implement workflow improvements to maximize process effectiveness and efficiency. Facilitate training and knowledge-sharing sessions regarding Agile methodologies and Scrum frameworks for the team and broader organization. Maintain clear, positive, and constructive collaboration and communication with internal and external IT teams. Execute additional responsibilities reliably as assigned by the Group Head.

jobs.title: B2B Sales Staff
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Develop and execute B2B sales strategies to identify, target, and secure high-value clients within premium packaging sectors, including cosmetics, luxury goods, consumer products, electronics, healthcare, and other high-growth industries. Drive market expansion and business development initiatives by identifying new market opportunities, customer segments, industry trends, and potential partnerships to strengthen JYX’s competitive position. Build and manage strategic relationships with key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and business partners to establish long-term partnerships and maximize customer lifetime value. Understand customer requirements and translate business needs into customized packaging solutions, collaborating closely with R&D, product development, design, engineering, and production teams to deliver innovative and commercially viable solutions. Lead the complete B2B sales lifecycle, including prospecting, customer qualification, solution presentation, technical discussion, pricing strategy, quotation preparation, contract negotiation, closing, and post-sales relationship management. Develop account growth strategies by analyzing customer potential, identifying upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and expanding JYX’s product portfolio penetration within existing accounts. Manage strategic negotiations with clients, ensuring optimal balance between customer satisfaction, profitability, production feasibility, and long-term business objectives. Prepare and manage sales forecasts, revenue targets, sales pipelines, and performance analysis using CRM systems and business intelligence tools to support data-driven decision-making. Monitor market intelligence and competitor activities, providing insights on pricing trends, customer preferences, industry movements, and potential risks or opportunities. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams including R&D, design, production, quality, supply chain, and finance to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction. Lead customer project management from concept to mass production, ensuring timelines, quality standards, cost objectives, and customer expectations are achieved. Represent JYX professionally at client meetings, industry exhibitions, trade shows, networking events, and strategic business forums to strengthen brand visibility and generate new business opportunities. Develop executive-level relationships with key decision-makers including procurement managers, brand owners, product managers, and senior management teams. Support business planning and strategic initiatives by providing market feedback, customer insights, and recommendations to improve product development and commercial strategies. Achieve and exceed annual sales targets, gross margin objectives, customer acquisition goals, and strategic growth KPIs. Strategic Performance Indicators (KPIs) New customer acquisition and market penetration Annual sales revenue and gross profit achievement Sales pipeline growth and conversion rate Key account retention and customer satisfaction New product/project development success rate Customer relationship strength and strategic partnership development Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline Contribution to market expansion and brand positioning Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification is an advantage. Minimum 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or key account management, preferably within the premium packaging, manufacturing, printing, FMCG, cosmetics, consumer goods, electronics, or related industries. Strong understanding of the B2B sales process, including market development, lead generation, customer qualification, solution selling, commercial negotiation, contract management, and long-term account development. Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, and managing high-value customer accounts.   • Develop and execute B2B sales strategies to identify, target, and secure high-value clients within premium packaging sectors, including cosmetics, luxury goods, consumer products, electronics, healthcare, and other high-growth industries.

  • Drive market expansion and business development initiatives by identifying new market opportunities, customer segments, industry trends, and potential partnerships to strengthen JYX’s competitive position.

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with key accounts, brand owners, distributors, and business partners to establish long-term partnerships and maximize customer lifetime value.

  • Understand customer requirements and translate business needs into customized packaging solutions, collaborating closely with R&D, product development, design, engineering, and production teams to deliver innovative and commercially viable solutions.

  • Lead the complete B2B sales lifecycle, including prospecting, customer qualification, solution presentation, technical discussion, pricing strategy, quotation preparation, contract negotiation, closing, and post-sales relationship management.

  • Develop account growth strategies by analyzing customer potential, identifying upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and expanding JYX’s product portfolio penetration within existing accounts.

  • Manage strategic negotiations with clients, ensuring optimal balance between customer satisfaction, profitability, production feasibility, and long-term business objectives.

  • Prepare and manage sales forecasts, revenue targets, sales pipelines, and performance analysis using CRM systems and business intelligence tools to support data-driven decision-making.

  • Monitor market intelligence and competitor activities, providing insights on pricing trends, customer preferences, industry movements, and potential risks or opportunities.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams including R&D, design, production, quality, supply chain, and finance to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.

  • Lead customer project management from concept to mass production, ensuring timelines, quality standards, cost objectives, and customer expectations are achieved.

  • Represent JYX professionally at client meetings, industry exhibitions, trade shows, networking events, and strategic business forums to strengthen brand visibility and generate new business opportunities.

  • Develop executive-level relationships with key decision-makers including procurement managers, brand owners, product managers, and senior management teams.

  • Support business planning and strategic initiatives by providing market feedback, customer insights, and recommendations to improve product development and commercial strategies.

  • Achieve and exceed annual sales targets, gross margin objectives, customer acquisition goals, and strategic growth KPIs.

    Strategic Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • New customer acquisition and market penetration

  • Annual sales revenue and gross profit achievement

  • Sales pipeline growth and conversion rate

  • Key account retention and customer satisfaction

  • New product/project development success rate

  • Customer relationship strength and strategic partnership development

  • Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

  • Contribution to market expansion and brand positioning

    Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification is an advantage.

  • Minimum 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or key account management, preferably within the premium packaging, manufacturing, printing, FMCG, cosmetics, consumer goods, electronics, or related industries.

  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales process, including market development, lead generation, customer qualification, solution selling, commercial negotiation, contract management, and long-term account development.

  • Demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, and managing high-value customer accounts.

  • Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify market trends, customer needs, competitive landscapes, and growth opportunities.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers, including brand owners, procurement teams, product managers, and senior executives.

  • Customer-focused, proactive, and solution-oriented, with the ability to understand customer challenges and provide value-added packaging solutions.

  • Experience working with CRM systems, sales reporting tools, and business analytics platforms to manage customer information, sales pipelines, forecasting, and performance tracking.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, PowerPoint, and presentation preparation for customer meetings and management reporting.

jobs.title: Operator Mesin Bubut
jobs.description: KUALIFIKASI: Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3 Teknik Mesin atau jurusan terkait. Warga Negara Indonesia, usia 20–40 tahun, sehat jasmani dan rohani. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai operator mesin bubut (lathe). Mampu mengerjakan komponen shaft dan disc non-standar, serta mampu membaca gambar teknik dan mengatur parameter mesin secara mandiri. Menguasai mesin bubut manual, dan memiliki pengetahuan dasar mesin bubut CNC menjadi nilai tambah. Terampil melakukan proses bubut seperti pengerjaan diameter luar, lubang dalam, ulir, dan permukaan tirus dengan kontrol pengerjaan yang baik. Mampu menggunakan alat ukur presisi dan melakukan pemeriksaan hasil kerja secara mandiri untuk memastikan kualitas produk. Pekerja keras, disiplin, mampu mengikuti aturan workshop dan prosedur keselamatan kerja. Bersedia mengikuti pengaturan jadwal produksi perusahaan. DESKRIPSI KERJA Mengoperasikan mesin bubut (lathe) untuk proses pengerjaan komponen mesin sesuai kebutuhan produksi. Mengerjakan komponen shaft dan disc non-standar sesuai gambar teknik dan spesifikasi yang ditentukan. Membaca gambar teknik serta mengatur parameter mesin secara mandiri sebelum proses pengerjaan. Melakukan proses pembubutan seperti pengerjaan diameter luar, lubang dalam, ulir, dan permukaan tirus dengan kontrol pengerjaan yang baik. Menggunakan alat ukur presisi untuk memeriksa hasil pengerjaan dan memastikan produk sesuai standar kualitas. Melakukan pemeriksaan mandiri terhadap hasil kerja untuk mencegah produk tidak sesuai standar. Mematuhi peraturan workshop dan prosedur keselamatan kerja selama proses produksi. Bekerja sesuai jadwal dan kebutuhan produksi perusahaan serta menjaga kedisiplinan dalam pekerjaan.

jobs.title: sales field
jobs.description: PT HomeX Global Integrator sedang membuka kesempatan untuk Sales Field yang memiliki pengalaman di industri bahan bangunan dan siap mengembangkan pasar, membangun jaringan pelanggan, serta meningkatkan penjualan di wilayah yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya. Jika Anda sudah terbiasa berhadapan dengan toko bangunan, distributor, agen, kontraktor, atau pelanggan proyek , posisi ini cocok untuk Anda. Apa yang Akan Anda Dapatkan? Gaji Pokok Komisi Penjualan Menarik Bonus Berdasarkan Pencapaian Target Kesempatan Pengembangan Karier Support dari Tim Internal Apa yang Akan Anda Kerjakan? Sebagai Sales Field HomeX, Anda akan berperan langsung dalam mengembangkan pasar dan meningkatkan penjualan perusahaan, dengan tanggung jawab: Mencari dan mengembangkan customer, toko bahan bangunan, agen, distributor, kontraktor, dan calon pelanggan baru . Melakukan kunjungan dan survey pasar untuk menemukan peluang penjualan baru. Memperkenalkan dan mempromosikan produk HomeX kepada pelanggan. Membangun serta menjaga hubungan jangka panjang dengan customer. Melakukan negosiasi harga dan kerja sama dengan customer, agen, maupun distributor. Mengumpulkan informasi mengenai harga, produk, promo, dan strategi kompetitor . Membantu customer menyusun kebutuhan dan daftar pembelian produk. Memasukkan pesanan customer ke dalam sistem ERP perusahaan . Berkoordinasi dengan tim Gudang & Logistik untuk memastikan pesanan dikirim tepat waktu. Melakukan monitoring pembayaran dan penagihan customer sesuai ketentuan perusahaan. Mencapai target penjualan dan membuat laporan aktivitas sales secara berkala. Kualifikasi Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Sales di industri bahan bangunan atau bidang yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman dan/atau jaringan dengan toko bangunan, distributor, agen, kontraktor, atau proyek menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan negosiasi yang baik. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target dan pencapaian penjualan . Memiliki kemampuan mencari customer baru dan mengembangkan jaringan. Memiliki kendaraan pribadi motor/mobil . Memiliki SIM aktif . Bersedia melakukan kunjungan customer dan survey pasar sesuai area kerja. pernah bekerja di Aplus, Mitra 10 dan Rucika menjadi nilai tambah Kami Mencari Orang yang Bukan sekadar bisa jualan, tapi mau membangun pasar. Kami membutuhkan Sales yang aktif mencari peluang, berani melakukan pendekatan kepada customer baru, mampu membangun relasi, dan memiliki motivasi untuk meningkatkan penghasilan melalui pencapaian penjualan.

jobs.title: TikTok Ads Specialist
jobs.description: Objective Role Mengakselerasi pertumbuhan revenue melalui strategi performance marketing berbasis data dengan fokus utama pada TikTok Ads serta pengembangan peluang pertumbuhan di channel digital lainnya. Job Description Bertanggung jawab mendorong pertumbuhan revenue, customer acquisition, dan efisiensi investasi iklan melalui strategi performance marketing berbasis data. Merancang, mengeksekusi, dan mengoptimalkan strategi performance marketing berbasis full-funnel pada berbagai platform digital dengan fokus utama pada TikTok Ads serta pengembangan channel potensial lainnya. Mengelola digital advertising campaign secara end-to-end mulai dari media planning, audience strategy, campaign setup, optimization, hingga scaling campaign. Mengembangkan framework testing yang terstruktur untuk audience, creative, offer, landing page, dan objective campaign guna menemukan peluang pertumbuhan yang dapat di-scale. Menganalisis performa creative dan memberikan insight kepada tim Creative, Content, dan KOL terkait konten yang menghasilkan performa terbaik. Mengoptimalkan campaign berdasarkan metrik utama seperti GMV, ROAS, CAC, CTR, CVR, AOV, dan revenue contribution. Mengelola dan mengalokasikan budget iklan secara efektif untuk mencapai target pertumbuhan bisnis dan efisiensi biaya akuisisi. Berkolaborasi dengan tim Brand, Creative, E-Commerce, KOL, dan Live Streaming untuk memastikan strategi marketing berjalan secara terintegrasi. Menyusun laporan performa mingguan dan bulanan serta memberikan rekomendasi strategis berbasis data untuk peningkatan performa bisnis. Memantau tren digital marketing, perkembangan platform iklan, perilaku konsumen, dan aktivitas kompetitor guna mengidentifikasi peluang pertumbuhan baru. Qualification Minimal 4–6 tahun pengalaman di bidang Performance Marketing, Digital Advertising, atau Growth Marketing. Memiliki pengalaman mengelola campaign conversion dan sales-driven campaign pada platform digital seperti TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, Google Ads, atau platform sejenis. Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat terhadap customer acquisition, conversion funnel, attribution, dan digital marketing analytics. Berpengalaman melakukan A/B testing dan optimasi campaign berbasis data. Mampu menganalisis performa campaign dan menerjemahkan data menjadi insight serta rekomendasi bisnis yang actionable. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan kolaborasi yang baik dengan tim Creative, Brand, E-Commerce, dan KOL. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target pertumbuhan revenue, ROAS, CAC, dan KPI performance marketing lainnya. Added Value Memiliki pengalaman di industri Beauty, Skincare, Cosmetics, FMCG, atau D2C Brand. Memiliki pengalaman mengembangkan dan scaling TikTok Ads untuk mendorong pertumbuhan penjualan. Memahami ekosistem TikTok Shop, Affiliate, dan Live Commerce. Berpengalaman tools analitik. Pernah memimpin project atau tim performance marketing.

jobs.title: Mandarin Translator 中文翻译员
jobs.description: 一、岗位职责 Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab 具备熟练中文听、说、读、写能力，顺畅对接中方人员日常工作沟通、事务对接及信息传达。 Memiliki kemampuan mendengar, berbicara, membaca, dan menulis Bahasa Mandarin dengan lancar, dapat menghubungkan dan menyampaikan informasi kerja sehari-hari dengan staf China dengan lancar. 熟练操作电脑及各类办公软件，独立制作、整理、编辑Excel表格与各类办公电子文档。 Mengoperasikan komputer dan berbagai perangkat lunak kantor dengan mahir, mampu membuat, mengatur, dan mengedit tabel Excel serta berbagai dokumen elektronik kantor secara mandiri. 负责统筹协调印尼本地员工日常工作安排、任务跟进及跨语种事务衔接处理。 Bertanggung jawab untuk mengkoordinasikan pengaturan kerja sehari-hari, pelacakan tugas, dan penanganan koneksi urusan lintas bahasa bagi karyawan lokal Indonesia. 承担日常中印双语口译、笔译工作，保障双方沟通准确高效。 Menangani tugas terjemahan lisan dan tulisan bilingual China-Indonesia sehari-hari, memastikan komunikasi kedua pihak akurat dan efisien. 完成上级领导临时交办的其他各项工作任务。 Menyelesaikan tugas kerja lain yang diberikan secara临时 oleh atasan. 二、任职要求 Persyaratan Jabatan 中文口语流利，读写规范，无障碍与中方团队高效沟通工作。 Berbicara Bahasa Mandarin dengan lancar, tulisan dan bacaan yang standar, dapat berkomunikasi dengan tim China secara efisien tanpa hambatan. 电脑操作熟练，擅长表格文档编制、数据整理归档等办公事务。 Mengoperasikan komputer dengan mahir, mahir dalam pembuatan tabel dokumen, pengaturan data, dan pengarsipan serta tugas kantor lainnya. 具备良好双语口译、书面笔译能力，沟通严谨细致。 Memiliki kemampuan terjemahan lisan dan tulisan bilingual yang baik, berkomunikasi dengan cermat dan teliti. 工作责任心强，服从工作调度，适应弹性加班安排。 Memiliki tanggung jawab kerja yang kuat, patuh terhadap pengaturan kerja, dan mampu menyesuaikan diri dengan jadwal lembur fleksibel. 熟悉印尼本地工作沟通模式，能妥善处理属地人员工作协调事宜。 Menguasai模式 komunikasi kerja lokal Indonesia, dapat menangani urusan koordinasi kerja dengan karyawan lokal dengan baik.

Part-time role supporting the Consumer Insight Team in a smartphone/mobile phone company. The role focuses on research operations, such as: recruiting research respondents, coordinating interview logistics, and providing operational support for consumer research activities.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1-2 years experience in market research, field operations for market research, research operations, respondent recruitment, and/or project coordination is highly preferred.

  • Strong communication +logistics organizing skills.

  • Comfortable conducting outreach through personal networks, communities, retail intercepts, or online channels.

    • Manage scheduling, confirmations, and incentive logistics.

    • Maintain a respondent database/tracker for future studies.

  • Video Shoot Support

    • Support on-site respondent interviews and product video shoots.

    • Coordinate locations, respondent arrivals, schedules, and equipment.

    • Provide basic production support during shoots.

  • Notetaking (Occasional)

    • Take structured notes during interviews or discussions when asked

    • Deliver organized notes in the agreed format within the required timeline.
